enabled.name: Pinned by fire (Tactical Shooting)
enabled.hint: NPCs shot at since their last turn roll Will-2 at the start of their turn (Combat Reflexes and Unfazeable are immune). Failure: they stay behind cover this turn.

radius.name: Near-miss radius (yards)
radius.hint: On a missed shot, tokens this close to the target are under fire too. 0 counts only the target.

pcs.name: Pinned by fire: PCs roll too
pcs.hint: PCs roll Will-2 as well. On a failure they may still leave cover, at minus the margin of failure on every roll that turn.

card.title: Under fire
card.pinned: {name} stays behind cover this turn (failed by {margin}). They may only act in ways that don't expose them: move further behind cover, communicate, reload.
card.pcPinned: {name} wants to stay behind cover. Leaving cover this turn means {penalty} to every roll.

cool-under-fire.name: Cool Under Fire (Tactical Shooting)
cool-under-fire.hint: Fright Check on the turn after a near miss (missed by 2 or less), being in a blast zone, taking a wound, or seeing an ally go down. Modifiers from Tactical Shooting p. 34 are filled in.

cuf-npcs.name: Cool Under Fire: NPCs
cuf-npcs.hint: NPCs roll automatically at the start of their turn; failure stuns them.

cuf-pcs.name: Cool Under Fire: PCs
cuf-pcs.hint: PCs get a card with a Fright Check button; failure costs SAN as for any Fright Check.

san.hint: SAN loss (success/failure) for this event when a PC fails or passes the check. These defaults are the fork's, not Delta Green's; set your own.
san.nearMiss: Cool Under Fire SAN loss: near miss
san.blast: Cool Under Fire SAN loss: blast zone
san.wounded: Cool Under Fire SAN loss: wounded
san.allyDown: Cool Under Fire SAN loss: ally down

card.title: Cool under fire?
card.gmMods: GM: also -1 if the attack's source is unclear, -2 non-penetrating hit, -1 blood on you, -1 to -3 knew the victim, +1 veteran, +1 each (or +5 all) for a plan, an ambush, 100+ yards.
card.pcFailed: {name} fails the Fright Check. GM: roll on the Fright Check Table.
card.pcPrompt: Fright Check now, with the modifiers above. SAN at stake: {loss}.

warn.notOwner: Only the character's owner can make this roll.
